method: Each l2d.su skin page opened by ID: title gives character and skin name, the model label gives LIVE2D or SPINE; Live2D+ from the site skin tile tag. The site catalog is encrypted since 2026-11 and was not decoded. Early skins (released before 2023-09-21, added from the WIKI on 2026-11-06) were found with desktop/tryout/site-lookup.cjs: the site search, the costume tile name and tag, and the model label shown after opening the tile.
